source_title: 'Public impeachment' of CEC Gyanesh Kumar: INDIA bloc event to begin shortly
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: The Congress-led INDIA bloc on Saturday unanimously passed a "motion" to "impeach" Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar in a "mock Parliament" held at Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's residence.The exercise was held amid allegations of irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls under Kumar's watch.Separately, The Indian Express reported last month that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections at least 14 times to decisions they alleged were taken without their knowledge. These included decisions concerning the SIR, adding to the scrutiny of Kumar.The "impeachment" exercise is being held a day ahead of the INDIA bloc's "Delhi Chalo" rally at Ramlila Maidan, where the opposition will seek Kumar's resignation.Ledaers of various opposition parties took part in the programme and accused CEC of "favouring" the BJP.INDIA bloc passes unanimously 'resolution' to 'impeach' CECINDIA bloc unanimously passes "resolution" to 'impeach' CEC Gyanesh Kumar at function in Kharge's residence.'Extremely dangerous political weapon sitting in garden of Rajya Sabha LoP's home'This looks like a meeting of Lok Sabha MPs, Rajya Sabha MPs, and common citizens. But actually, this is a political weapon. This is an extremely dangerous political weapon that is sitting in the garden of the Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha, and this weapon is targeted directly at every single person, starting from Mr Gyanesh Kumar, going to Mr Modi, going to Mr Shah, and every single person who has colluded to destroy the vote of the Indian people. Remember, you will not always hide behind that institution.
